可房子里好像总缺点儿什么。
到底缺什么呢？

三位天才级创作者，
用这个温暖又俏皮的故事告诉我们，
什么样的房子才算得上真正的家。
page_text_en:
Mr. Bear wants to build a wonderful house,
but it seems like something is always missing.
What exactly is missing?

Three genius creators
use this warm and playful story to tell us
what kind of house truly counts as a home.
